$comment: Declarative form of the persisted task record. Mirrors the current checks in src/tasks.mjs validateTask (lines 348-409), the shape written by createTask (lines 192-208) and the artifact fields updateTask may add (src/service.mjs:192-224). It is deliberately stricter than today's validateTask at three points, as the adoption target: unknown object keys are rejected, the taskId pattern is the runtime identifier pattern (UUIDv4 is a submit-time product rule, not a store check), and attempts[].outcome must be a non-empty string when present (the store never checks it). The record may also carry branch, which src/service.mjs:207 reads and no runtime writer sets today. Checked by src/contracts/validate.mjs; the meta block is ignored by the checker.

taskId.description: Opaque UUIDv4 identifier; the store only enforces the identifier pattern.

payloadHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the canonical payload.

request.description: The validated submit request without clientSessionId; see task-submit-request.schema.json.

createdAt.description: Epoch milliseconds. Non-negativity is not expressible without a minimum keyword and stays imperative.

outcome.description: Recorded by the executor adapter; the store does not validate it today.

executionStopped.description: True only when the worker confirmed no work is running; 'unknown' after an abort, crash or restart.

effectsReverted.description: Cancellation is a request, never proof that effects were undone.

block.description: Null unless the task needs maintainer reconciliation.

testRuns.description: Test runs recorded by the executor through updateTask. command is optional because the runtime tolerates a run without one (src/service.mjs:192-199) and reports the missing command as a limitation.

branch.description: Optional branch recorded by an executor; src/service.mjs:207 reads it and no runtime writer sets it today.
